savings.title: Savings & deposits
savings.whyTitle: Why a separate account for savings
savings.whyBody: Money you can’t see in your everyday card is easier not to spend. One deposit per savings envelope keeps each goal visible.
savings.lookFor: When choosing a deposit, check that it is covered by the deposit insurance system, the withdrawal and top-up terms, and the effective rate.
savings.noEndorsement: UMANI doesn’t recommend specific banks or products. This is education, not financial advice.
